hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.py ]] && uv run ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; }

REPO=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*github.com[:/]//') && jq -r '.tool_response // ""' | grep -qF "$REPO" && gh pr view --json number -q .number >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh pr comment --body '@codex review' 2>/dev/null || true
